subject: Mobile Development
title: Dark Patterns in Mobile Design
description: A 60-second lesson on Dark Patterns in Mobile Design.

hook.text: The big green button says 'Accept All.' The tiny gray text says 'Manage preferences.'

buildup.text: Dark patterns are design tricks that manipulate users into actions they didn't intend.

discovery.text: Confirm-shaming, hidden unsubscribe flows, and forced continuity are common dark patterns.

twist.text: The EU now fines companies for dark patterns. California has similar legislation pending.

climax.text: Dark patterns boost short-term metrics but destroy long-term trust and invite regulation.

punchline.text: Tricking users works once; trust works forever.

quiz.question: What are dark patterns?
options: Design tricks that manipulate users into unintended actions
